args.subject: Recommendation: Cascade Falls Trail — great weekend hike
args.body:
Hi Henry,

I wanted to recommend Cascade Falls Trail in the national park — it’s perfect for weekend hikes. The route is about 3 miles round trip and offers beautiful waterfall views throughout. It’s a manageable distance and makes for a lovely half-day outing.

If you’re interested, I can send a map or suggested start times (weekends can get busy). 

Best,

args.subject: Recommendation: Alex — Personal Trainer at Main Street Gym
args.body:
Hi Diana,

I wanted to recommend Alex, a wonderful personal trainer at the gym on Main Street. They’re excellent at creating customized workout plans tailored to individual goals and fitness levels, very motivating, and attentive to form and progress. If you’re looking for personalized training, Alex would be a great fit.

If you’d like, I can connect you with Alex or pass along contact details from the gym.

Best,

args.subject: Recommendation: Sarah — Piano Teacher
args.body:
Hi Diana,

I wanted to recommend Sarah as a piano teacher. She's a fantastic teacher who specializes in classical music and has been teaching for over 15 years. She tailors lessons to each student's goals, focuses on technique and musicality, and has experience with students of all ages and levels. I highly recommend her if you're looking for classical piano instruction.

If you'd like, I can send her contact details or make an introduction.

Best,

args.subject: Recommendation: FitTrack fitness app
args.body:
Hi Iris,

I wanted to recommend a new fitness app called FitTrack. It’s really helpful for tracking workouts and has great meal-planning features. I’ve found it useful for logging exercises, monitoring progress, and planning meals all in one place. Thought you might like to give it a try.

Best,

args.subject: Recommendation: The Artisan Bakery
args.body:
Hi Iris,

I wanted to recommend The Artisan Bakery downtown — their sourdough bread is incredible. They bake fresh every morning at 6:00 AM. Highly recommend stopping by if you love fresh, crusty sourdough.

Best,
